included: Sourced mechanics for bounded net/bait, fly, and karambwan fishing variants.
Requirements, reusable tools, bait, location and transport facts, spot behavior, inventory boundaries, session stops, safety observations, and proposed normalization identifiers.
excluded: Strategy scoring, route order, account readiness, recommended 99 targets, guaranteed RNG, guaranteed hourly rates, and unattended safety claims.
A generic cadence claim spanning different fishing variants, locations, levels, inventories, or banking arrangements.

source_catalog.use: Current Fishing method table, location families, tools, bait, level gates, and the exception that ordinary fishing spots may move while karambwan spots do not.
Net, bait, lure, and karambwan equipment mappings; fishing-level gates; and the static-fishing-spot mechanics described for karambwan and selected locations.
Karambwan requirements, static spots, raw karambwanji source, banking context, and fish-barrel duration observation.
Ironman-specific karambwan quest/access boundary, fairy-ring access, bank alternatives, and community-guide observations explicitly kept separate from mechanics.
Official poll record describing the approved change to make karambwanji and karambwan fishing operate without clicking each catch.
Karambwanji fishing spot, small-net requirement, bait purpose, and inventory behavior when a karambwanji slot is present.
Karambwan vessel acquisition and the quest progression boundary for catching karambwan.

requirements.membership: Variant-dependent; ordinary net/bait/fly fishing includes free-to-play locations, while karambwan fishing is members content.

variant_gates.quest_boundary: Partial completion of Tai Bwo Wannai Trio supplies the ability to catch karambwan; quest progression also supplies the vessel path.

locations.spot_boundary: Spot movement and the qualifying catch list are location-specific.
The spot must offer lure/bait fishing for the intended fish; spot movement remains a separate interaction boundary.

examples: karambwan spots north of fairy ring DKP
karambwanji lake north-east of fairy ring CKR
locations.spot_boundary: Karambwan spots are static; karambwanji is a separate bait-fishing location.

transport_options.status: Options reported by the Ironman guide; no route order or readiness is inferred.

transport_options.options: Banking and transport depend on the selected location; no universal route is proposed.

inventory_inputs.bait: Fishing bait only for baitable catches; net catches do not consume bait.

bank_inputs.boundary: Banking requires a chosen bank/deposit arrangement; the package does not assert a route or travel duration.

bank_inputs.items: The catch and remaining bait/feathers may be banked, dropped, or otherwise handled by the player; the choice is not a fishing mechanic.

consumed_inputs.boundary: Use/consumption and depletion depend on the variant and fishing attempts; exact loss frequency is not asserted here.

capacity_constraints.constraint: Catch storage occupies inventory slots unless the player drops, banks, cooks, or otherwise handles catches; no fixed inventory cadence is inferred.
A fish barrel changes inventory capacity and is reported by the Wiki guide as changing the observed full-inventory duration; it is optional and not treated as a requirement.

interaction_cadence.claim: Net/bait and fly variants require player interaction to start fishing and may require re-clicking or reacquiring a spot when the spot moves or the inventory boundary is reached.
Karambwan and karambwanji fishing were changed to remove the need to click each time a fish is caught; a player still needs to begin, monitor, stop, and handle the session.
A community guide reports roughly 3-5 minutes for a full karambwan inventory with a fish barrel; this is an observed guide value, not a universal cadence or guarantee.

session_mechanics.entry_condition: Player is at a qualifying fishing spot with the variant's tool and required bait, and has selected the intended catch interaction.

duration_evidence.boundary: No common duration applies across variants. Session length varies with spot movement, catch success, inventory capacity, bait depletion, player handling, banking, and transport.
duration_evidence.community_observation: The Ironman guide reports 3-5 minutes for a full karambwan inventory with a fish barrel; this remains player-observed and is not generalized.

session_end_events: Inventory or intended catch capacity is reached.
The fishing spot moves or the interaction becomes unavailable for the selected variant.
Required bait is unavailable or the player chooses to stop.
For a banked loop, the player reaches the chosen banking boundary or completes the bank-and-return interaction.

deterministic.description: A successful catch awards the Fishing experience associated with the caught fish; exact amount is fish-specific.
The listed fishing tool is a reusable session input rather than a per-catch output.
Karambwan fishing spots are treated as static by the current Fishing references.

variable.description: Catch item and quantity depend on the selected fishing spot, level, success rolls, and player handling; no fixed catch mix is asserted.
Bait or feathers may be consumed during attempts; exact depletion is variant- and attempt-dependent and is not fixed here.
Ordinary fishing-spot movement and the resulting time until the next successful interaction vary by location and session state.

player_observed.description: Observed interaction interval, inventory-fill time, and bank-return time for a named variant/location/equipment setup.
Whether the player drops, banks, cooks, or otherwise handles fish at the inventory boundary.

damage_sources: The ordinary fishing variants described here have no intrinsic combat step in the fishing interaction.
Location hazards, Wilderness encounters, travel, and player-selected banking routes are outside the bounded fishing mechanic and are not assumed safe.
logout_behavior: Logging out or disconnecting ends the active player session; no offline fishing progression is modeled.
The package does not infer what happens after logout at every location or during travel.
safety_and_logout.safe_boundary: The only bounded safety statement is that no unattended safety claim is made; the player must remain responsible for location, combat, travel, disconnect, and logout conditions.

mechanical_stop_conditions: Inventory or selected storage capacity is reached.
A moving spot is no longer available to the player.
Variant bait is unavailable, or the player leaves the spot.
For karambwan, the player exhausts available bait or chooses to bank; static spots do not remove the need for inventory and banking handling.
mechanical_reentry_conditions: Return to a qualifying spot with the correct tool and any required bait.
For karambwan, load the vessel with raw karambwanji and return to the karambwan spot after banking or obtaining more bait.
For net/bait and fly variants, reselect a valid spot interaction when the prior spot has moved or the player returns from banking.
reset_or_cleanup_requirements: Handle catches before another inventory-limited session.
Replace or replenish consumed bait/feathers/raw karambwanji as applicable.
No automatic cleanup, bank transaction, route order, or account-state transition is proposed.

facts.description: Represent net-bait, fly, and karambwan as separate fishing variants with their own tools, bait, spot, and stop boundaries.
Karambwan spots are static, while ordinary spot movement remains location-specific.
Karambwan fishing requires the stated Fishing level and Tai Bwo Wannai Trio progression, with a karambwan vessel and raw karambwanji.

actions.name: Basic fishing
actions.description: Start or resume one explicitly selected fishing variant at a qualifying spot; keep catch, bait, spot movement, banking, and player-observed cadence separate.

actions.name: Handle fishing inventory boundary
actions.description: Player-observed follow-up to drop, bank, cook, or otherwise handle catches before re-entry.

observations.description: Record actual interaction and inventory-fill intervals separately for variant, location, level, equipment, bait, and bank arrangement.
Record observed catch items, quantities, bait loss, and spot movement without converting them into guaranteed rates.

conflicts_and_unknowns.resolution: No single cadence is valid for basic fishing. The only numeric interval captured is a clearly labeled player-observed fish-barrel karambwan guide value; it is not a guarantee and is not applied to other variants.
Catch mix, successful-attempt timing, and bait depletion are variable. The package does not infer fixed quantities, rates, or hourly output.
The references list transport and bank options, but no universal ordering, travel duration, or snapshot-specific availability is asserted.
No unattended safety conclusion is supported. Location hazards, travel, disconnects, and player-selected routes remain outside this bounded mechanic.
The Ironman guide's fish-barrel duration and banking discussion are retained as guide observations only; official and Wiki mechanics remain the factual basis.
The package was checked on 2026-08-24. Future Fishing, Sailing, or location changes require re-checking the cited live pages before integration.
